results.rule_summary: Expand each cell of the 3x3 input grid into a 3x3 block in a 9x9 output grid: if the input cell is non-zero, replace it with a full copy of the input grid; if the input cell is zero, replace it with an all-zero block.
Fill the interior (enclosed regions of background color 0) of shapes made of color 3 with color 4.
Split the 6-row input into two 3-row blocks, then construct the 9-row output by repeating the blocks in the order: block 1, block 2, block 1, while changing all color 1 to color 2.
Shift the left and right boundaries of each row of the hollow shape to the right by 1 column, except for the bottom row which remains unchanged.

A 3x3 template shape (defined by color 8) is replicated based on the dimensions of input line segments: a vertical line of length N produces N horizontal copies of the template shape, and a horizontal line of length N produces N vertical copies of the template shape, each separated by single-pixel spacing.
